Ham, Cheese, and Broccoli Turnovers
By: Maria Kollision
Published: Tuesday, November 19, 2013 - 2:11pm

Ingredients




1 tube prepared crescent roll dough
4 ounces deli sliced low-fat ham
4 ounces shredded low-fat Cheddar cheese
4 ounces chopped broccoli florets

Preparation

1 Preheat the oven according to the crescent roll package directions. 2 Unroll the crescent roll dough, and place flat. 3 Place 1 ounce each of the ham, cheese, and broccoli onto each of 4 triangles of dough. 4 Top each with another triangle of dough, and pinch the edges closed. 5 Place the turnovers on a cookie sheet, and bake according to the crescent roll package directions, or until the dough is golden brown and flaky.

About

These are great for lunch or dinner. They're very portable, and contain 2 servings of vegetables apiece.
View the full post here: http://savorytraditions.wordpress.com/2013/11/11/ham-cheese-and-broccoli-turnovers/
